summary: Explore the power of data visualization with D3.js on our website. Learn how to create stunning visualizations to make sense of your data effectively.
lede: D3.js data visualization connects structured data to browser-based charts that support analysis and interaction. For analysts, business intelligence practitioners, and front-end developers with basic JavaScript, the course covers loading and validating CSV or JSON, mapping values with scales, building SVG charts, and adding responsive, accessible interactions.
audienceIntro: This D3.js data visualization course suits professionals who need to create or commission interactive web-based charts and communicate analytical findings clearly. It supports foundation-level learners with basic JavaScript exposure and gives intermediate practitioners a structured way to improve chart architecture, accessibility, and delivery quality.
modules: D3 Scales, Axes, and SVG Marks
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with a modern web browser, a code editor such as Visual Studio Code, and permission to create local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files. TrainingCred provides practice CSV and JSON datasets, starter files, reference examples, chart checklists, and digital exercise templates. No commercial software licence is required. You will not need to install a database, cloud platform, or specialised visualization server.
